heuristic_overrides.aws_lex_bot: the plain name heuristic hits AWS::Lex::Bot, but that CFN type's own docs ("Amazon Lex V2 is the only supported version in CloudFormation") state it models Lex V2 only; aws_lex_bot is the legacy V1 bot, already correctly claimed by aws_lexv2models_bot's overlay alias - see the cfn_unmodeled entry below for aws_lex_bot's actual classification
heuristic_overrides.aws_lex_bot_alias: same V2-only gap as aws_lex_bot above: the plain name heuristic hits AWS::Lex::BotAlias, but that CFN type's own docs carry the identical "Amazon Lex V2 is the only supported version in CloudFormation" note (BotId's pattern/length constraints match V2's opaque bot IDs, not V1's numeric bot name+version scheme) - aws_lex_bot_alias is the legacy V1 bot alias, and the provider ships no aws_lexv2models_bot_alias to claim the V2 type instead

cfn_unmodeled.aws_lex_bot: Lex V1 has no registry model; AWS::Lex::Bot is V2-only per its own docs, corresponding to aws_lexv2models_bot
cfn_unmodeled.aws_lex_bot_alias: Lex V1 has no registry model; AWS::Lex::BotAlias is V2-only per its own docs (same note as AWS::Lex::Bot), and the provider has no V2 bot-alias resource to claim it instead
